protocol: leave-one-site-out; each of the 13 sites is held out once, the other 12 train. No validation split: the epoch count is fixed in advance and no epoch is selected on held-out data.

arms.soft: CRF, fixed effective penalty 7.046, gate frozen, no regulariser (added in revision, reviewer 2)

batch_size_note: batch-size 1 is required to reproduce the published grid. A run at batch-size 2 reproduced only 6 of 39 cells; that grid is archived under rerun/discarded_batchsize2_results.jsonl.
